snippet.title: Maplayer One | Global MapleStory
snippet.description:
MapleStory Classic World had its Grand Launch on October 21, 2026. A whole new world, built on the one players already loved.
Global MapleStory and Classic World are both full of players who never thought they'd share one name. This is the moment all Maple players come together as one.

Maplayer One. 🍁

A new era of MapleStory begins November 11th.

Play Global MapleStory and Classic World Now: https://www.nexon.com/maplestory/
